description: Patch a stored trip (trip_id from get_trips or log_travel): title, city, country (null clears), start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD), kind (trip|residence|soft_pin), confidence (confirmed|likely|possible; status follows as log_travel sets it), evidence (null clears). Fields left out stay. Its private calendar event from log_travel follows the title, dates and place. Inferred trips (ids starting inferred:) are calendar events: edit those with update_event. Archived trips need restore_trip first. ($0.10; API key required)

city.description: A real city (not a region or state).

confidence.description: How certain the stay is: confirmed, likely or possible, e.g. confirmed.

evidence.description: Source note (Gmail id, booking, address); null clears it.

kind.description: Entry kind: trip, residence or soft_pin, e.g. trip.

request_id.description: Client idempotency key (retries return original result).

title.description: Trip title, e.g. Tokyo spring trip.

trip_id.description: A stored trip id from get_trips, get_trip or log_travel.

name: update_trip

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

event_id.description: The trip's calendar event that followed the change, or null.

provenance.description: Which connector wrote the record and which connected Dayze account received it.

account.description: The Dayze account this data belongs to. With more than one Dayze connection, name it in the answer.

note.description: How to disclose the account to the user.

qa_fixture.description: True for a known QA test account: its records are fixture data, not a real life.

name.description: The connected app or API-key label shown to the account owner.

source.description: chatgpt for ChatGPT OAuth writes; mcp for another OAuth app or API key.

trip.description: The stored trip after the change.

title: Update Trip
